entries.28dcb1b8efe4cb83: 'i-Filter' is filtering software targeted at homes, libraries, internet cafés and similar venues, and it controls access to harmful sites from smartphones, tablets and PCs.
entries.299b44e77262e55f: 'm-FILTER' consists of email filtering, email archiving and anti-spam functions, and is used for targeted email attack countermeasures, prevention of misdirected emails, spam email countermeasures and similar purposes.
entries.29e1b43d423de5a4: 'm-FILTER' consists of email filtering, email archiving and anti-spam functions, and is used for targeted email attack countermeasures, prevention of misdirected emails, spam email countermeasures and similar purposes. It determines the safety of senders using a whitelist-based database that stores safe senders.
entries.2bd199493095427c: 'a-FILTER' is an integrated authentication platform providing single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, ID synchronization, log management and similar functions. 'Z-FILTER' is a network security solution that provides ID authentication, device control, communication control and visibility of cloud service use, among other functions, on a single management screen; official sales began in November 2025.
entries.3b0bdcf818fb5812: 'FinalCode' is a passwordless encryption service that can track and remotely control electronic files, enabling designation of viewers, changes to permissions and remote file deletion.
entries.514e0f535b4881a8: "DigitalArts@Cloud" is cloud security covering Web, email and files, which addresses both external attack countermeasures and internal leakage countermeasures, and can display the status across them on an integrated report screen.
entries.599bd4af082517db: 'a-FILTER' is an integrated authentication platform providing single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, ID synchronization, log management and similar functions.
entries.7656a439512c6124: The main product "i-FILTER" is a Web filtering product that uses a whitelist-based database to block access to unregistered threat URLs and to control browsing by category. It is used for countermeasures against targeted attacks, Web access control, access log monitoring and similar purposes. A cloud version, "i-FILTER@Cloud", is also offered.
entries.86494a2d949ea713: A domestic security software maker that plans, develops and sells Web and email security software, listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.90c4c47cedddf3c8: This is the group's only reportable segment, which plans, develops and sells Web security, email security, and file encryption and remote deletion solutions, among others. Sales of ¥10,835 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were all from this segment, and sales by market were ¥5,256 million for the public sector market, ¥5,176 million for the corporate market and ¥402 million for the consumer market.
entries.d251b1ab0957ffd3: 'FinalCode' is a passwordless encryption service that can track and remotely control electronic files, enabling designation of viewers, changes to permissions and remote file deletion. 'f-FILTER' is a data protection and file transfer solution for securely transmitting important information.
